title: Click-Clack Cuttlefish
statement: Hovering amid towering stacks of slate that resemble sunken bookshelves, this inquisitive miniature cephalopod spends its hours sorting frosted sea glass into intricate mosaics with soft, rhythmic clicks. Whenever a visitor leans close to the swaying kelp canopy, ripples of warm amber and twilight-blue bioluminescence dance across its skin like a sudden spark of recognition.
